status: concept pending owner visual review; Icon Composer layering follows approval
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / logo-brand.
Asset type: a single square app-icon concept for the macOS clipboard manager Clipio.
Edit target: the supplied existing Clipio icon.
Primary request: preserve the recognizable friendly brown pony in its yellow banana costume, and greatly simplify the icon for legibility at 32 px. Keep the same gentle three-quarter pony face, large dark eye, brown muzzle, yellow banana hood and small brown stem.
Composition: one large pony head-and-hood silhouette, plus one simple translucent clipboard silhouette as the secondary cue. Use large clean shapes and generous separation. The pony is the visual focus.
Remove the smartphone, window traffic-light dots, tiny lettering, miniature document rows, multiple stacked cards and fine fur texture. Reduce the clipboard to its clip and a plain rounded rectangular surface.
Style: refined friendly macOS icon illustration, soft simple three-dimensional forms, restrained Apple Liquid Glass material on the clipboard and background. Keep the pony face opaque and readable. Warm yellow costume, brown pony, neutral pale warm-glass background. Crisp silhouette edges and a few controlled highlights.
Output: one 1024x1024 square artwork, full-bleed background, no outer whitespace, no lettering or labels, no outside drop shadow. Supply square unmasked artwork for a later system app-icon mask. This is a visual concept to review before Icon Composer layering.
